messages:
jen: NovaTech (ops@novatech.io) signed up via Google SSO and can't see any API keys in the Console. Their integration calls are getting 403 "project not found". Sales flagged this as P1, customer blocked. signup webhook id: signup-2026-03-22-3311. Can someone look?

marco: on it. do we have an example curl + response? also confirm SSO vs email sign-up.

jen: they used Google SSO. example (redacted):

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxxREDACTEDxxx" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","input":"test"}'

Response:
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "Project not found or access denied"
}

infra-bot: onboard-service: signup-2026-03-22-3311 processed; created project novatech-prod under org_id org_sales_shared_06; created api_key id key_ab12 (masked).

rachel: that looks like the wrong org. likely case where SSO identity already exists in our system and onboarding picked the existing org membership instead of creating a new org for the tenant. we've seen this pattern with invite+SSO.

marco: ok plan: (1) create a rescue key under the real org (org_nova_88, project novatech-prod), (2) revoke the incorrect key under org_sales_shared_06, (3) give customer the new key and advise rotation, (4) file an engineering remediation ticket. anyone can run adminctl?

jen: I can. which scopes? customer needs generation + embeddings for initial test. make it least privilege: generate:write, embed:read. add tag onboard-rescue and link to INC-4599.

marco: command to run:

```
adminctl keys create --org org_nova_88 --project novatech-prod --scopes generate:write,embed:read --tag onboard-rescue
```

jen: created key sk_rescue_nova_xxREDACTEDxx and attached to novatech-prod. revoking key_ab12 under org_sales_shared_06 now and adding audit note referencing INC-4599.

support-bot: key key_ab12 revoked; audit note added (INC-4599).

novatech_ops (customer): tested the new key, calls now return 200 and they can see the key in Console. "Thanks — works now, please explain cause so we can update our onboarding checklist."

rachel: root cause: onboarding flow associates new SSO signups with the first existing org membership found for that identity instead of forcing new org creation when no invite token is present. fix: require explicit new-org creation confirmation in SSO flow unless an invite token selects an org, and add a safegate that flags any onboarding that would reuse an unrelated org.

marco: created ENG ticket ENG-3120 (onboarding: prevent cross-org assignment for SSO signups). added steps: (a) require explicit new-org selection or confirmation, (b) log and alert when onboard-service would attach to an org that differs from signup_org in webhook payload, (c) backfill audit for last 60 days to find similar cases (query: onboard-service where created_org != signup_org).

jen: follow-ups assigned: INC-4599 (support: customer rescue + revoke) -> jen, marcos; ENG-3120 (engineering) -> rachel. UX to add explicit "Create or join organization" screen for SSO flows.

rachel: quick runbook for support if this shows up again:
1) ask for signup webhook id (signup-YYYY-MM-DD-XXXX) and example call/response
2) check onboard-service events via support-bot or logs
3) if key created under wrong org -> create rescue key, revoke wrong key, create INC/attach audit
4) escalate to ENG-3120 and confirm backfill results

marco: pinging sales to confirm billing mapping and to ensure invoice goes to NovaTech (not the shared sales org).

jen: closing thread w/ customer confirmation and rotation guidance. marking resolved. :white_check_mark: 

(+2 :thumbsup:)
